subject.title: msteams: support Copilot-only streaming without enabling Teams DM streaming

question: Should the Microsoft Teams plugin add a supported Copilot-specific streaming override, and if so which config shape and activity metadata should define the Copilot surface?
rationale: The source limitation is clear, but the permanent config contract and reliable Copilot detector are product/API choices that automation should not invent without live Microsoft 365 activity evidence.

options.title: Approve per-surface config after live metadata proof
options.body: Add a plugin-owned detector and config such as streamingBySurface or copilotStreaming only after a redacted Copilot custom-engine activity sample proves the discriminator.

options.title: Keep global streaming only
options.body: Decline the new config surface and document that operators must choose one Microsoft Teams streaming mode for all personal conversations.

options.title: Defer behind a broader Teams surface model
options.body: Wait for a general Teams surface abstraction if maintainers expect more Copilot/team/group behavior to diverge soon.

recommendation.title: Approve per-surface config after live metadata proof
recommendation.body: Add a plugin-owned detector and config such as streamingBySurface or copilotStreaming only after a redacted Copilot custom-engine activity sample proves the discriminator.

likelyOwner.reason: Brad Groux has recent adjacent Teams streaming/config history and owns the broad Microsoft tracker where this issue is listed.
